description: A Java Spring Boot REST controller class defining endpoints for CRUD operations on products, including listing, retrieving by id, creating, updating, and deleting products. It utilizes Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: ProductController
classes.description: REST controller that manages product CRUD operations via HTTP endpoints.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET /products, returns list of all products.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Handles GET /products/{id}, returns a product by its ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST /products, creates a new product.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT /products/{id}, updates an existing product.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE /products/{id}, deletes the specified product.
